summary: The storage architecture is a layered, protocol-checked dispatch system. StorageFacade owns the user API surface; a runtime registry maps provider types to backend classes; each backend implements 0–8 granular storage protocols à la carte; settings classes produce SDK-ready kwargs via adapter dispatch; a stream transform pipeline composes around backend I/O at the facade layer.

concepts.name: Protocol-checked dispatch layer
recommended_docs: _require(protocol, operation) enforces capabilities at call time. supports(protocol) is the introspection API. 8 protocols: Connection, Read, Write, List, Delete, Metadata, Copy, Directory.

concepts.name: Runtime backend registry
recommended_docs: _backend_registry: dict[CONST_STORAGE_PROVIDER_TYPE, type]. Side-effected at import time via @register_storage_backend. get_storage_backend() instantiates. Registry is populated by importing storage_backends package.

concepts.name: Path → provider detection
recommended_docs: detect_provider_from_path() maps URL scheme → CONST_STORAGE_PROVIDER_TYPE. SCHEMES dict defines canonical scheme strings. Bare paths map to LOCAL.

concepts.name: Spec-driven settings pipeline
recommended_docs: StorageDescriptor (spec metadata) → StorageProfile (base settings class with to_handler_kwargs()) → per-provider concrete class (with __adapter__ class var) → adapter module (lazy SDK kwargs). STORAGE_REGISTRY enables name-based spec/settings lookup.

concepts.name: S3-family flavor dispatch
recommended_docs: S3Settings.FLAVOR: Literal['aws','express','r2','minio','b2'] controls endpoint URL, session token type, and bucket naming. R2 endpoint URL derived from ACCOUNT_ID via ParameterSpec.template. Express requires zone-aware bucket names.

concepts.name: Stream transform composition
recommended_docs: Pipeline is outermost-first. apply_read strips outer→inner; apply_write wraps inner→outer (reversed). Facade applies pipeline around backend.read_to_stream() and backend.write_from_stream(). _PairedStream closes both wrapper and backend stream.

concepts.name: Suffix-driven pipeline inference
recommended_docs: SUFFIX_TRANSFORMS dict. Right-to-left suffix parsing. Stops at first unknown. infer_pipeline returns (Pipeline | None, stripped_path). Integrated into facade.read() and read_bytes() via infer=True.

concepts.name: Backend protocol composition pattern
recommended_docs: Backends are composed of per-operation modules (local_read.py, local_write.py, etc.) assembled into a single class. HTTP implements only Read+Write+Metadata; list/copy/delete raise UnsupportedOperationError. Local implements all 8 protocols.

concepts.name: Dual registry pattern
recommended_docs: Two registries serve different roles: storage_registry.registry is the runtime backend dict keyed by CONST_STORAGE_PROVIDER_TYPE. settings.registry is the spec/settings lookup keyed by provider name string. They are independent.

documentation_plan: Architecture diagram: facade → registry → backends → protocols
